plans.title: Plans
plans.description: What is free on Forever Sixty for good, what Premium, Guild and Raid guild add, and what each costs.

band.heading: What is free, and what the plans add
band.lede: The free list never shrinks. Premium and the guild plans pay for the site, and there are no ads for anyone.

guildRegion.heading: For guild leaders
guildRegion.lede: The Discord bot, raid posts, sign-ups and the recruiting channel are free for every claimed guild. A plan adds the officer tools. Members never pay.
guildRegion.members: Plans count verified members: players with a Forever Sixty account whose character the guild has confirmed. People in your Discord without an account do not count.

rules.sentence: Each player counts once, however many characters they have in the guild. A character counts once an officer approves it, it joins by the guild's invite link, or it shows in the guild's logs. Discord members without an account do not count.
Guild counts verified members each day, the leader included. Above 25 the officer is told before renewal and offered Raid guild.
One person's card pays for the plan. Members cannot split the bill on the site.
The subscriber or the guild leader gives each seat to any verified member. A seat holder has Premium while the plan lasts.
A seat can move once every 30 days. The old holder keeps Premium until it moves. If a holder leaves the guild, the seat comes back at once.

A member who pays for Premium accepts a seat first. Their own Premium stops renewing and the seat starts when it ends, so nobody pays twice. If the seat is taken away later, they get a link to come back at the price they had.
A guild's first 7 days are free, once per guild. The card is added at the start, and guild settings shows the date of the first charge from day one. Cancel before day 8 and nothing is charged.
We email 7 days before every yearly renewal, to the address you gave Stripe at checkout. Cancel in Manage billing; the plan runs to the end of the period you paid for.
The subscriber hands the plan to another officer from guild settings. The founder price goes with it.

Email help@foreversixty.gg for a refund. Cancelling stops the renewal and the plan runs to the end of the period you paid for; there are no part-period refunds. If you were charged twice, or paid for something that did not work, we put it right.

faq.question: What happens if I cancel?
faq.answer: You keep everything through the end of the period you already paid for. After that, the account works like a free one, and nothing is deleted. A guild's records stay readable for good.

faq.question: Is anything from Battle.net ever paid?
faq.answer: No. Your characters, your sign-in, and everything the game itself tells us about you stays free, always. Blizzard's own rules for using their data require this.

faq.question: Are there ads?
faq.answer: No, for anyone. The site is paid for by Premium and the guild plans.

faq.question: Who am I paying?
faq.answer: Commish LLC d/b/a Forever Sixty. Your card statement reads FOREVERSIXTY. Stripe handles the payment; we never see or store your card.

coach.title: Your Fury coach
coach.opening: Solid kill: you were alive the whole fight and Battle Shout was up 100% of it. Almost everything you left behind sits in one button.

fixFirst.title: Bloodthirst: 9 casts lost
fixFirst.why: Bloodthirst is the button the Fury rotation is built around, and 9 casts went unused while you had the rage, longest at 1:12–1:25. At 2:44–2:58 you sat on a full bar instead, so that one gap cost you two Bloodthirsts.

then.title: Rage full for 14 seconds in total
then.why: When the bar is full, Heroic Strike turns rage into damage instead of losing it.

notifications.label: Discord
notifications.intro: Get a message in a Discord channel when a server sim finishes or a log finishes parsing.
howSteps: In Discord, open the channel's settings, then Integrations, then Webhooks.
Choose New Webhook, name it something you will recognize, then Copy Webhook URL.
notifications.trustHelper: We store the URL encrypted, never show it again, and delete it with your account.
notifications.eventUploadParsed: A combat log you upload finishes parsing
notifications.eventsNote: Off: private logs are never posted. On: the channel sees the log's name and “Only you”.
notifications.removeQuestionPasted: Remove this webhook? Posts stop and we forget the URL. It stays in Discord until you delete it there.
notifications.removeQuestionConnected: Remove this connection? Posts stop and we delete its webhook from Discord.
notifications.connectExplanation: Discord asks for a server and a text channel, not a voice channel, then lets Forever Sixty post there. You need Manage Webhooks permission in that server. We keep only that webhook, encrypted.
notifications.reconnectNote: Connecting again replaces this channel and removes its webhook from Discord.
notifications.reconnectAside: The old channel stops getting posts.
notifications.returnConnected: Connected. Send a test message to see it in your channel.
notifications.returnDenied: Cancelled in Discord. Nothing was connected.
notifications.returnFailed: Could not connect. You need to be able to manage webhooks in that channel. Ask a server admin, or paste a webhook URL instead.
notifications.connectStuck: Discord did not open. Try again, or paste a webhook URL instead.
notifications.destinationChannel: Posts to a channel in your Discord server
notifications.savedFirst: Saved. Send a test message to see it in your channel.
notifications.testRateLimited: Wait a minute before sending another test.
notifications.testOurError: Could not send the test. Try again.
notifications.removeFailed: Could not remove it. Try again.
notifications.saveFailed: Could not save that. Try again.
notifications.invalidUrl: That is not a Discord webhook URL. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
notifications.notEntitled: Discord messages are part of Premium.
notifications.switchedOff: Switched off after 5 failed posts in a row.
notifications.switchedOffFix: Fixed it in Discord? Test and switch on. If the webhook is gone, make a new one.
notifications.lapsedTitle: Posts are paused because your plan ended.
notifications.lapsedBody: We kept your webhook. Posts start again when you are back on Premium.
notifications.freeSentence: Discord messages tell you when a server sim or a log you uploaded is done.
